meta.title: useOptimistic — show the result now, confirm when the server answers

annotations.label: Component declaration
annotations.detail: Todos adds an item instantly with useOptimistic while the (fake) server call is still in flight. The optimistic item disappears and is replaced by the real one when the request finishes.

annotations.label: Optimistic layer over real state
annotations.detail: optimisticTodos is derived from todos on every render. While the transition is pending it includes the extra item; once setTodos commits the real list, the extra item is no longer needed.
